qualification.details: AP Bio Medical Engineering: B.E/ B.Tech and Master's in relevant branch with first class or equivalent either in B.E/ B.Tech or Master's degree. AP Electrical & Electronics: B.E/ B.Tech and Master's in relevant branch with first class or equivalent either in B.E/ B.Tech or Master's degree. AP Electronics & Communication Engineering: B.E/ B.Tech and Master's in relevant branch with first class or equivalent either in B.E/ B.Tech or Master's degree. Librarian: Good academic record with knowledge of Computerization of Library, having at least 55% marks (50% excluding any grace marks, in case of SC/ ST/ Differently-abled category/Ph.D holder who have obtained their Master's Degree prior to 19th September 1991) or equivalent at Master's level in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation Science or equivalent professional degree. Must have cleared NET/ SLET/ SET. Ph.D holders as per UGC Regulations 2009 exempted from minimum eligibility conditions of NET/ SLET/ SET.

content_sections.heading: JKPSC Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the JKPSC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download JKPSC Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: JKPSC Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 6 vacancies are available – 2 for AP Bio Medical Engineering, 2 for AP Electrical & Electronics, 1 for AP Electronics & Communication Engineering, and 1 for Librarian.

content_sections.heading: JKPSC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: AP Bio Medical Engineering: B.E/ B.Tech and Master's in relevant branch with first class or equivalent either in B.E/ B.Tech or Master's degree. AP Electrical & Electronics: B.E/ B.Tech and Master's in relevant branch with first class or equivalent either in B.E/ B.Tech or Master's degree. AP Electronics & Communication Engineering: B.E/ B.Tech and Master's in relevant branch with first class or equivalent either in B.E/ B.Tech or Master's degree. Librarian: Good academic record with knowledge of Computerization of Library, having at least 55% marks (50% excluding any grace marks, in case of SC/ ST/ Differently-abled category/Ph.D holder who have obtained their Master's Degree prior to 19th September 1991) or equivalent at Master's level in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation Science or equivalent professional degree. Must have cleared NET/ SLET/ SET. Ph.D holders as per UGC Regulations 2009 exempted from minimum eligibility conditions of NET/ SLET/ SET.

content_sections.heading: JKPSC Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 40 years Age Relaxation: Reserved categories: 43 years; Physical Challenged: 42 years

content_sections.heading: JKPSC Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Rs. 15600 - 39100 Per Month For Assistant Professor posts: Rs. 15,600-39,100 + AGP Rs. 6000 (Pre-revised) For Librarian post: Rs. 15,600-39,100 + AGP Rs. 6000 (Pre-revised)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the JKPSC Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of JKPSC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JKPSC Assistant Professor/Librarian posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the JKPSC Assistant Professor/Librarian recruitment is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Assistant Professor/Librarian posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for the Assistant Professor/Librarian posts released by the Jammu and Kashmir Public Service Commission.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: For Assistant Professor posts, candidates need a B.E/B.Tech and Master's degree in the relevant branch with first class or equivalent.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these JKPSC posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to these posts is 40 years, with relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC category candidates is Rs. 1200.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee for SC/ST category candidates is Rs. 700.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for JKPSC Assistant Professor/Librarian recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Examination followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 15600 - 39100 Per Month, with an AGP of Rs. 6000 (Pre-revised) for Assistant Professor posts.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates apply offline for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, applications must be submitted online through the official JKPSC website.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for JKPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
